build_task_scene: build a PHYRE task scene with a jar, obstacle bars, and a ball using the creator API
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object centered at scene midpoint with a given scale
add_static_bar: add a static bar obstacle with a specified angle, bottom position, and horizontal alignment
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object at a specified center x and bottom position in the scene
update_task_relationship: update the task to define an INSIDE spatial relationship between a ball and a jar
